primaryStandards.description: I can use function notation and interpret functions.
I can use structure to rewrite expressions.
I can add, subtract, and multiply polynomials.
I can divide polynomials and interpret remainders.
I can apply polynomial identities and operations.
I can factor and rewrite expressions to reveal structure.
I can identify complex solutions of quadratic equations.
I can solve higher-degree polynomial equations.

attemptPolicy.belowMasteryAction: Teacher of Record intervention and release of another randomized attempt.
attemptPolicy.questionReuseRule: Questions must not repeat exactly across attempts.
